headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 22 at 7:05PM PST until November 24 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal flooding
expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 4 AM PST Tuesday.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 4 AM Tuesday to 1 PM PST
Friday. Most susceptible time of flooding will be around the
time of the morning high tide, with peak tides trending from 7
AM on Monday to 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peak Tuesday through
Wednesday, reaching 7.9-8.3 feet, likely re-breaking the all-
time tidal records set back in late October. Background surf
on top of the tides will remain around 3-5 feet through
Wednesday, but an incoming swell Wednesday into Thursday will
bring a sharp increase to the surf by Thursday morning's high
tide. Breaking waves may reach 6-8 feet with sets up to 10
feet on west-facing beaches. Surf then moderates some into
Friday, but still looks to be around 5-8 feet.
